name: Mectronx Corp
old_description: Expedite the design cycle with industry-leading turn times on electronic assemblies.  Our unique capabilities are provided in an encompassing assembly suite, from PCB builds to complete product assemblies.  Mectronx provides OEMs with a one-stop prototype through production facility to build your module in the shortest lead time.
about:
Mectronx Corp operates from Oconomowoc, Wisconsin. The company's founding year is not publicly disclosed, but it achieved ISO 9001:2015 certification on May 29, 2018. Steve Lechtenberg serves as president.

Mectronx is a contract manufacturer specializing in electronic assemblies, offering services from rapid PCB prototyping to full turnkey production. Its climate-controlled, ESD-compliant facility handles surface-mount and through-hole assembly, conformal coating, encapsulation, selective and wave soldering, robotic dispensing, plasma treatment, and functional testing. The shop supports prototypes and low-to-medium volume runs, processing thousands of part numbers daily with capabilities for up to 200 unique SMT BOM items and 1,000+ placements per board.

The company serves OEMs and design firms across industries including consumer electronics, energy, agriculture, construction, industrial equipment, and marine. Typical applications involve silicone keypads, power distribution, Bluetooth and cellular connectivity, GPS tracking, LED lighting, motor controllers, and sensor assemblies.

Mectronx emphasizes speed and transparency, advertising 3-day PCB turns and same-day manufacturing for prototypes, with a quoted defect rate of 153 parts per million. Its safety-stocking program secures long-lead components early in the design cycle, and the firm maintains that its ISO 9001:2015 system has been in place since its first year of operation.
